history.title: History & Expertise
history.description: Began in 2013 in Xiamen, China. We specialize in manufacturing carbon fiber bicycle rims and wheels, successfully innovating and industrialising the supply of lightweight carbon fibre rims to the bicycle industry.

scale.title: Scale & Capacity
scale.description: More than 20 experienced engineers in R&D and 250+ effective workers. Monthly capacity of 25,000 rims. 100% quality testing and inspection helps ensure all rims meet UCI/ISO standards.

innovation.title: Innovation & Tech
innovation.description: Multiple patented technologies support production. We mainly use Toray carbon fiber, including T700 mixed with T800/T1000, to balance weight, stiffness, and durability.

leader.title: Industry Leader
leader.description: We are a trusted OEM/ODM supplier in the carbon fiber rim industry, with strong relationships with bicycle brands worldwide.

process.title: Manufacturing Process
process.description: From raw material to final packing: precision at every step.

step01.title: Prepare and control epoxy resin
step01.description: We purchase raw materials from reliable suppliers and produce the optimal epoxy resin for carbon rims.

step02.title: Produce carbon prepregs
step02.description: Different kinds of carbon fibers from Toray Japan are saturated with epoxy resin through weaving machines to produce carbon prepregs.

step03.title: Store prepregs at stable temperature
step03.description: Carbon prepregs are kept at -5°C, a stable temperature that preserves the resin in optimal condition.

step04.title: Cut carbon sheets to precise angles
step04.description: Sheets are cut to 0, +/-45, +/-30, and +/-90 degrees, then precisely machine-cut into pieces.

step05.title: Prepare laminations for rim sections
step05.description: Lamination prepares different rim sections with carbon sheets so the product can be arranged more easily while balancing weight, durability, and rigidity.

step06.title: Premold and hand layup
step06.description: Technicians hand-lay fabric layers from outer to inner, smoothing each overlap to avoid wrinkles, fractures, and air bubbles before closing the premold.
step06.alt: Carbon rim premold and hand layup workshop

step07.title: Cure rims under heat and pressure
step07.description: Complete molds move to molding machines where heat and pressure are accurately controlled and monitored in curing ovens.

step08.title: Inspect every rim visually
step08.description: All rims are inspected for appearance and obvious defects before moving to the next process.

step09.title: Drill spoke and valve holes
step09.description: Rims are drilled on aviation-grade CNC machines with composite-specific bits to ensure correct angles and clean holes.
step09.alt: CNC machining workshop for carbon rims

step10.title: Control rim weight precisely
step10.description: Weight standards are strictly controlled, with measurements accurate to 1 gram.

step11.title: Prepare surfaces by sanding
step11.description: After inspection, rims move to the sanding workshop to prepare surfaces for the next processes.

step12.title: Refine critical surfaces
step12.description: After sanding, rims move to grinding to refine key surfaces and ensure consistency.

step13.title: Handle fine details
step13.description: A dedicated workshop focuses on rim details so small finishing decisions do not compromise quality.

step14.title: Perform additional tests
step14.description: Drainage holes, spoke holes, and appearance are checked again before shipment.

step15.title: Apply finishes where required
step15.description: Ultralight rims are paintless, while traditional rims receive glossy, matte, or custom finishes in the painting workshop.

step16.title: Apply waterslide decals
step16.description: Rims that require waterslide decals are processed here for branding and graphics.

step17.title: Laser carve logos and marks
step17.description: Rims that require laser-carved logos are processed here for a durable, precise finish.

step18.title: Final inspection and packing
step18.description: All rims are inspected again, protected with foam bags, and carefully packed into cartons.
step18.alt: Carbon rim inspection and packing workshop

step19.title: Store rims in an organized warehouse
step19.description: Clear classification and compliant warehouse operations help maintain model and order accuracy.
